comment: Canonical OD scenarios for the front-end JS Dijkstra. Node IDs are stable identifiers from the map's tignes.json. If you regenerate the graph (skiroute.build_graph), the IDs may shift — re-derive them from named features (lift/run top/bottom) and village bases.

scenarios.label: Fresse lift bottom → Tignes Le Lac
Grande Motte top → Tignes Val Claret
Funival top → Val d'Isère La Daille
Tignes Val Claret → Val d'Isère Centre (inter-valley)
Fresse top → Mont Blanc run (the worked example)
Grande Motte → Val Claret on prefer-easy minimises blacks
scenarios.comment: Grande Motte (3447m) is the highest point in Tignes; the glacier summit has 'Descente' (advanced) as effectively the only exit. We allow ≤ 1 black leg and rely on the cost penalty to keep it minimal.

scenarios.label: prefer-easy is never faster than any-piste (same OD)
Digues home run: bottom of piste must reach Tignes Le Lac
scenarios.comment: Digues is purely a 'home run' — used at end of day to ski back to accommodation. Without the manual override (Digues bottom → Lavachet bottom skate edge in tignes_overrides.json), this OD pair was unreachable. Regression test ensures the override survives future rebuilds.
